text:
Aisha (CS): Quick heads-up: PioneerPay is going live with their BNPL pilot next Tue 09:00 UTC for Brazil + Canada. They asked for three customer-specific changes: 1) temporary QPS increase for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings, 2) add CDN CIDRs to our edge allowlist, 3) route Brazil traffic to eu-west1 and Canada to northamerica-northeast1. Can eng/sre scope impact and rollback?

Andre9s (PioneerPay): Traffic profile: baseline ~150 QPS on generate, short warmup spike to ~800 QPS for ~45m during peak. Embeddings traffic similar but lower. CDN egress: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/25. Launch timing is firm; avoiding 429s is critical.

Dina (Acct Mgr): Reminder: renewal touchpoint in ~18 days. Smooth launch observed by commercial will influence renewal conversations. Happy to coordinate exec sync after launch.

Leo (Eng): Feasible. Options: soft-priority routing (no reserved GPUs) or temporary dedicated burst pool. Soft bump may work with caching; dedicated pool gives stronger guarantees. Need decision on reserved capacity. Also can add per-customer rate profile and CIDR allowlist entries.

Andre9s (PioneerPay): Prefer safety net. Soft bump OK if SLA-equivalent behavior is guaranteed (p99 < 250ms for /v1/generate). If error rates spike, auto-fallback to a smaller model is acceptable.

Ravi (SRE): I'll create a temporary rate profile and update allowlist. For guaranteed headroom we'll open a 2-hour burst pool around launch; autoscale down post-window. Will add rollout + rollback runbook.

Aisha (CS): Can we do a 30m canary at 08:30 UTC before the main window? Also PioneerPay requested telemetry pings during the window to their ops webhook.

Leo (Eng): Canary OK. Draft plan: - customer tag: pioneerpay-prod - rate_profile: steady 150, burst 900, window 120m - allowlist: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/25 - region routing: brazil -> eu-west1, canada -> northamerica-northeast1 - fallback: gpt-medium -> gpt-small - canary 2026-03-17T08:30:00Z, launch 2026-03-17T09:00:00Z

Andre9s (PioneerPay): Add webhook: https://hooks.pioneerpay.io/redwood-launch. We'll send HMAC token via secret manager. Ping every 1m during 2h window is requested.

Ravi (SRE): I'll wire the webhook via Vault stored secret, implement retries, and add a pre-launch smoke test: 50 synthetic requests over 5m. Rollback triggers: sustained 5m error rate >3% or p95 latency >500ms. Ops-bot will post infra ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-7821 created. Assigned: Leo, Ravi. Priority: P2.

Leo (Eng): I'll push config as a canary deploy then full rollout. Will include fallback chains and metrics collection: token-level cost delta, p95 latency, sample outputs. Will validate webhook signature X-Pioneer-Signature HMAC-SHA256.

Dina (Acct Mgr): I'll schedule the renewal follow-up and invite the renewals lead and PioneerPay execs.

Ravi (SRE): Infra notes: will not reserve GPUs until capacity approves; if capacity tight, we fallback to priority routing. Created INF-7821 runbook and attached rollback steps. Pre-launch reminder scheduled T-1h.

Aisha (CS): I'll update the customer ticket and mark renewal note. Post-launch sync set for 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC. Reopen thread if blockers appear.

Andre9s (PioneerPay): Thanks everyone. We'll monitor and can request extension of burst window if needed.

Leo (Eng): Confirmed. Leaving final check: ensure webhook headers validated and secret rotated post-launch.

Ravi (SRE): All set from infra side. Will post status in #customer-success during and after the window.

Aisha (CS): Closing for now. Good luck :rocket:
